long_biography.plain_text:
A consulting assignment at Uljanik brought Jørgensen to Croatia in 1971. Working there connected the Danish specialist to an Adriatic commercial network that shaped his subsequent career. He later formed a business alliance with Croatian entrepreneur Juroslav Buljubašić, whose SEM Maritime enterprise provided the roots of their passenger carrier.

Jørgensen held equity in Blue Line International and ran the business as its senior executive. During its operating years, he stood at the centre of strategic decisions and public communications for services between Croatia and Italy. The carrier later stopped operating. Jørgensen is also listed among the owners of Catamaran Line, an active Croatian water-transport company, although his percentage and management duties are not disclosed. His career establishes investment combined with operational leadership, but it leaves present control and the source of his acquisition capital unresolved. Any ships, income, route concessions, passenger totals or balance-sheet values belonged to the companies and cannot be counted as Jørgensen's individual property.
